text.tspan: Share of the working-age population (ages 15 and older) who are employed.

tspan.tspan: ILO Modelled Estimates, via World Bank (2026)
All figures correspond to modeled ILO estimates. Employment is defined in line with the 13th ICLS and includes the production of goods

text.tspan: for own use, such as subsistence farming. Where data for 2025 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2020 and 2024 is
